issues: Numeric labels near move buttons are most likely base move power and are NOT confirmed cooldown seconds; first TinyFish report conflated them.
Team builder supports editing move selection and choosing three for 3v3, but does not mean all Pokémon are available/unlocked.
Charizard was benched during this specific match; no actual Fire or Dragon visual evidence.
Raw screenshot images were not independently preserved in this file; confidence restricted to agent's live report.
All copied observations are research metadata only; no original source art or third-party source code is included.

Second attempt to force Charizard active failed: game server was in a brief update and no practice battle started. Do not label Charizard's Flamethrower, Fire Blast, Dragon Claw animations as observed.
The catalog now contains 119 distinct static move names; source declaration alone does not license copying third-party art, prove runtime animation, or establish units of 'cooldown'.
